# base-class step 0x82283898 calls, with the same float and the same position
# pointer it gives the integrator.
# IT IS THE ORIENTATION UPDATE, and it closes the loop with A3.1. The three
# rotations it applies are the three that reconstruction/ace-combat-6/src/
# retail_transform.cpp already ports, in the order retail_transform.h already
# records (0x820A9B30 first, 0x820A99F8 second, 0x82211828 third).
# So the flight controller and the transform kernel are the same code, which is
# what the campaign's steering required: one shared kernel, not two substitutes.
# THE THREE CONTROL AXES ARE THE THREE ANGLE SOURCES. Slot 30 (0x82302DB0,
# ported as retail_flight_controls) writes +304, +308 and +312; each is the
# multiplier of exactly one rotation. That assignment is derived here and was
# not available from either function alone.
# step   what runs                                   angle
# stage
